selection: Four pools: consistent dynamic gain versus both controls; consistent loss versus both; all-model agreement; largest prediction spread. Four candidates per pool per dataset, unique video IDs within each dataset. Candidate review only, not final six cases. All test records retained.
eligibility: Valid nonnegative timestamps and 11-character video ID; 3 <= clip seconds <= 25, 5 <= word count <= 60, cache retains every original word and downstream subwords are not truncated; gains/losses require >=4/5 paired seeds versus each control.
blind_annotation: Separate worksheet omits labels, model outputs and selection groups. No claim of independent blind annotation by the selecting analyst.
media_evidence: Do not annotate voice/facial cues until corresponding media is observed.
checkpoint_selection: Existing frozen dev-selected checkpoints; no test selection or retraining.

timestamp_sources.mosi: Original label CSD intervals by zero-based segment index, label agreement verified
timestamp_sources.mosei: GLoMo PKL metadata, exact video/start/end; no external media synchronization verified yet
